title: Just Improved Eyes
description: Improves the texture of babies eyes in the new update
body:
# Just Improved Eyes
## 📔 About 📔
The latest Minecraft update gave baby mobs unusual eye textures, making them look unnatural and strange.

This resource pack replaces baby mob eye textures with more natural and appealing variants:

- Strider
- Llama
- Hoglin & Zoglin
- Piglin & Zombified Piglin
- Fox

Now they look the way Minecraft nature intended!

## 🔧 Installation 🔨
1. Click the "Download" button
1. Move the file into your .minecraft/resourcepacks folder
1. Open Minecraft → Options → Resource Packs
1. Activate the pack
1. Done!
